caseName: The Orchard Was Never the Secret
title: Lainey & Cord

questions.text:
I'm sorry to drag you into this. I didn't know who else to ask. 🙏
Almost every night after eleven, his phone buzzes and he walks out to the porch to take it.
Who keeps calling him that late at night?

Fencing. At midnight. Sure.
Nobody sells fence posts that late, and he never orders anything without telling me about it for a week.
Who is really on the other end of those late-night calls?
questions.hint: In Messages, open the thread with the contact from his late-night calls and look at how the texts are signed.

questions.text:
A woman. I knew it. 😔
I've met every Bea, Becca and Beth in Marion County at one potluck or another. Not this one.
What does Bea do for a living?
questions.hint: Look in Mail for a sender with that first name and read to the bottom of her email.

questions.text:
So it's money. Not a woman. I can actually breathe. 🥲
He's been short with me ever since the loan letters from the co-op started coming. Now I know why.
Who is buying the orchard?
questions.hint: In Mail, there's more than one email about offers. Find the one that actually went through.

questions.text:
Two months before our wedding and he hasn't said one word about selling.
I draft closing documents for a living. He could have asked me to look anything over.
When is the sale of the orchard supposed to be final?
questions.hint: Calendar has an entry with a short, cryptic title. Match it with who has been emailing him about the sale.

questions.text:
That's before our wedding. 😳
Picking season is almost here. He can't be out half the night and still keep the trees looked after.
Who has been covering for him while he's gone?
questions.hint: Go through the WhatsApp chats with the crew and family. One of them is clearly sick of keeping a story straight.

questions.text:
I've known Ruben since high school. He never could lie to my face.
On those nights Cord texted me he was helping a cow calve at Ruben's and not to wait up.
Where did he actually sleep on those nights?
questions.hint: Find the nights he texted Lainey that excuse in Messages, then check RevoBank for the same dates.

onboarding.text: He left his phone charging by the coffee maker and drove off to an auction before five. I've been sitting at the kitchen table looking at it for an hour. I need help, and I need it this morning.
onboarding.label: Lainey

onboarding.text: I'm Lainey. Cord and I are getting married at Willow Creek Barn in two months. He proposed in the packing shed under string lights, with the whole crew whooping. I said yes before he finished asking.
onboarding.label: Lainey & Cord

onboarding.text: Cord Halvorsen runs his family's orchard, four generations of apples outside Pella, and keeps the co-op's books on the side. Quiet, steady, up before the sun. Lately he comes home at three in the morning.
onboarding.label: Cord

onboarding.text: I'm a paralegal. I don't make claims I can't support. So I'm not going to accuse him of anything until I've seen it for myself. Go through his phone with me. One question at a time.
onboarding.label: Lainey

msgs.text: Stopping at Hy-Vee on the way home. Anything besides coffee?
Tug's food. And the good butter.
The good butter is seven dollars.
Worth it.
Happy Valentine's. Left something in the truck for you ❤️
A thermos? With a bow?
Thermos with a bow. Keeps coffee hot till noon.
I love it. Dinner's on me tonight. Pot roast.
Marla emailed. Tasting dates are open next month.
Whatever works for you. I trust your calendar more than mine.
That isn't saying much. Mine is color-coded.
Frost warning tonight. Checking the fans before supper.
I'll keep the oven on. Bring Ruben if he's hungry.
He says yes. He always says yes to your cornbread.
Tug got into the compost again.
Of course he did. Is he sick?
No. Smug.
Your mom called me about Easter. Ham or lamb.
Ham. Dad won't touch lamb.
I'll tell her. I'm bringing the rolls.
Tasting went well. The barn smells like cedar.
Wish I could've been there. Co-op books ate my afternoon.
I picked the chicken. You get the pork if you want to be difficult.
Chicken is great.
Bud break on the Honeycrisp rows. Come see after work.
Leaving the office at five. Save me a row.
Dentist at nine tomorrow. Remind me or I'll forget.
Reminding you. Dr. Patel. Nine. Floss tonight.
Yes ma'am.
Your phone rang at 3 this morning. I heard it from the kitchen.
Co-op alarm system. Glitchy again.
Okay.
Mother's Day lunch is at your mom's. Noon. I'm bringing pie.
Which pie?
Rhubarb. The one she taught me.
She'll cry.
That's the plan.
Annika sent dress photos. Option two. I think.
Option two. She's got taste.
You haven't seen it.
I trust her.
Hay's down in the east block. Rain by evening.
I'll bring in the laundry.
Invitations proof came. Want to look at it tonight?
Yes. After I wash up.
The font is serif. You said you wanted serif.
Serif is right.
Ruben's heifer is calving, don't wait up
Okay. Is she alright?
Should be. Long one.
Tell Ruben I said good luck.
You home?
Pulling in now. Sorry. Heifer's fine.
Good. Coffee's on.
Can you pick up the ring from the dresser and bring it to me at lunch? It keeps sliding. I'd like to get it measured.
Already took care of it. It's getting cleaned before the wedding. Greta's got it.
Oh. Okay. I'll miss it on my hand.
Back soon. Promise.
Again? Okay. Be careful on 163.
Will do.
Cord. It's 5:40. Did you sleep at all.
Some. Heading in.
Fourth of July leftovers are gone. Tug had the last hot dog.
Traitor dog.
Okay.
I'm not asking you anything. I'm just saying okay.
Love you. Go to sleep.
Honeycrisp bins are stacked in the shed. Ruben counted 212.
That's a lot of pie.
Wedding is two months out tomorrow. Just noting it.
I know. I'm working on it.
Leaving for the equipment auction. Back around noon. Phone's on the charger, grab it if you need it.
Reminder: monthly invoices due to the office by the 25th.
Got it. Sending the batch tomorrow
Prairie Valley Co-op: The monthly invoice batch is posted to the shared drive.
Got it. I'll reconcile Tuesday afternoon.
Office closed for the holiday. Back on the 6th.
Thanks. Left the signed sheets on Carla's desk
Board meeting moved to 4 PM. Bring the inventory sheet.
Will do.
Prairie Valley Co-op: our office hours this week are 8 to 4:30.
Thanks, I'll be in for the books at 1
Reminder: member newsletter goes out next week. Send any announcements by tomorrow.
Nothing from me this time
Your parking permit for the receiving lot renews at the end of the month.
I'll stop by the front desk
Thanks, Cord. Fertilizer delivery arrives early next week.
The break room fridge is being cleaned out. Please take your items by 5 PM.
Nothing of mine in there. Besides one yogurt 😅
Noted. We'll save the yogurt.
Reminder: Gwen is out tomorrow morning. Call the main line for scale tickets.
Hy-Vee Pharmacy: Your prescription is ready for pickup. Reply STOP to opt out.
Hy-Vee Pharmacy: Time to refill your prescription. Reply 1 to refill.
Hy-Vee Pharmacy: Refill confirmed. Ready after 2 PM today.
Hy-Vee Pharmacy: Your prescription is ready for pickup. Rx 7740213.
Hy-Vee Pharmacy: Reminder, your prescription is still waiting. Pickup by end of week.
Picking it up tonight.
Hy-Vee Pharmacy: Refill available for Rx 7740213. Reply YES to request.
Hy-Vee Pharmacy: Your prescription is ready for pickup. Reply STOP to opt out.
Hy-Vee Pharmacy: Reminder, your order is still waiting at the counter.
Picking it up today
Thanks! Pharmacy hours today are 9 AM to 6 PM.
Hy-Vee Pharmacy: Your order has been picked up. Thank you!
Hy-Vee Pharmacy: A flu shot clinic is open at your Pella location starting next month. No appointment needed.
Hy-Vee Pharmacy: You have 1 refill remaining on a current prescription. Reply R to refill.
R
Hy-Vee Pharmacy: Refill received. We'll text you when it's ready.
Hy-Vee Pharmacy: Your refill is ready for pickup.
Cord! Come to the book club thing at the library. Free cookies
Is the book a farm book
It's a mystery. Nobody dies on a farm. Mostly
I'll think about it
Hi Cord, Gwen at the co-op. Can you do your books afternoon this week? Quarter-end is coming
I can do 1 to 5 on both days
Perfect. I'll leave the folder on your desk
Quick one: vendor invoices from Pioneer are in two different formats. Want me to ask them to switch?
Yes please. PDF only, one invoice per file
Will do
The VLOOKUP on the member dues sheet is returning #N/A for about 12 rows
Probably trailing spaces in the member IDs. Wrap the lookup value in TRIM
That fixed it. You're a wizard
Just tired of the same bug 😅
Do you want the board packet printed or emailed?
Emailed. I'll print my own copy if I need it
Coffee maker in the office died. I bought a new one, expensing $48 under supplies
Fine. Code it to office supplies, not equipment
Ha, ok. Equipment sounds fancier
The auditor's coming in two weeks. Can you reconcile the fuel accounts before then?
I'll have it done by the end of next week
Thank you. I know it's a lot on top of the orchard
It's fine. The orchard doesn't run on spreadsheets, thank God
Can I get a flat of strawberries for the fundraiser?
We don't grow strawberries. I know a guy in Oskaloosa though
Send me his number
Texting it now
You're a peach. Er, apple
Fuel accounts balance. Two receipts missing from the Casey's card, $31.20 and $44.75
I'll dig through the glovebox of the co-op truck
Found both under the seat 🙄
Classic. Put them in the folder
Audit went fine. Auditor said the books were the cleanest he's seen in a while
Good to hear. Give yourself some credit too
Can you move your hours to mornings next week? Dentist
Mornings are tough with the crew. I can do 2 to 6 instead
That works, I'll come in late too
Board wants to add a line to the budget for a new scale at the receiving dock
Get me two quotes and I'll put it in the capital sheet
On it
Quote one: $3,850. Quote two: $4,200 with install
Take the second, install matters. I'll add it tomorrow
Okay. Hey, is everything alright with you? You've seemed distracted
Just a lot going on. I'm fine
Alright. Offer stands if you want to talk
Thanks Gwen
Folder's on your desk for tomorrow. Bring the green pen, mine ran out 😄
14 degrees. Heard 4 inches coming.
Saw. Tarps are on the equipment.
Good.
Rain by noon. 70 percent
Saw it. Putting off the dormant spray
Good. Wind's out of the east. That's a bad sign
Dad, it's just wind
We'll see
Frost warning tomorrow night.
Got the wind machine fueled.
Check the oil.
Yes sir.
Hawkeyes got a good recruit I read. QB from Cedar Rapids.
Saw that. Spring practice looked decent.
Defense always wins.
Is the Kubota fixed?
Dealer has the part ordered. Couple days.
Should've changed the hydraulic filter in the fall.
I know.
Just saying.
Did you see the Hawkeyes got that lineman from Cedar Rapids
Saw it. Maybe the line holds this year
I'll believe it in October
Rain gauge says 1.8 inches.
Mine says 2.
Yours is wrong.
Your tractor tire on the old Ford is low. Left side
I'll get the compressor on it after lunch
Compressor's got a bad hose. Use mine in the barn
Okay thanks
Need to borrow your post hole digger.
It's on the hook in the shed. Take it.
Will return.
Corn looks good on the Vander Molen place. Dean says good year.
Hope it holds.
Hail on the radar west of Knoxville. Heading our way maybe
Checking now. Crew's pulling off the north block
It split south. Missed us
Thank God. Dinner's on me this week
Heat index 104 today. Make sure the crew drinks water.
Done. Cooler's loaded, shifts end at one.
Good man.
Hawkeyes season ticket renewal came in. You in this year?
Yeah, put me down for two.
Alright.
Looks like a derecho risk this week. Watch the sky.
Will do. Crew's got eyes out.
Good.
Rain tomorrow, finally. Maybe an inch.
Cord, Nate. You still got that pole saw? Got a dead limb over my shed roof
Yep. Come grab it. It's hanging in the machine shed
Thanks. Will have it back by the weekend
Brought the saw back, left it by your door. Tug barked at me the whole time
He's a good guard dog for a collie 😂
Extension meeting on scab and fire blight is tonight at the community center. Going?
Yeah, I'll swing by. Save me a seat in the back
They're saying wet spring. Plan on extra fungicide
Of course they are
Can I borrow the sprayer next week? Mine's got a cracked pump
Need it myself later in the week. Take it for the first half and I'll grab it back
That works. I'll fill it with my own water
Sprayer's back. Cleaned it out. Pump seal might need replacing
Thanks man. I'll check it
Heard your sprayer is down. Mine's free if you need it
Appreciate it. Replacing a nozzle, should be fixed by noon
Offer stands
Got a sec to talk drainage on the west lot? Standing water again
Call you after supper
Cool. I'll be on the porch
Hail came through my north field. Anything at your place?
Pea sized. Dinged a few leaves, nothing on the fruit yet. How bad for you?
Lost some corn. Insurance guy coming tomorrow
Sorry man. Need a hand, call
Appreciate it
Codling moth traps — how many you catching?
Eleven per trap in the east block. Spraying first thing tomorrow if the wind lets up
Same here. Thanks. I'll match your schedule
Pie at the diner this weekend? I'm buying
If I'm done by 2
Rhubarb or cherry
Apple. Obviously
Of course 😂
Dry spell is killing me. Pond is down a foot
Drip lines are running all night. Water bill's going to be ugly
Rain tomorrow they say. 70 percent
I'll believe it when it's on the roof
Got an inch and a quarter last night!
Same. Gauge says 1.3. Whole farm smells like wet dirt
Best smell in the world
Lending you my disc harrow for the fall if you want it
Yes please. I'll swap you for a bushel of Honeycrisp
Deal
Co-op annual meeting dinner is coming up. Going?
Probably. Prime rib again?
Chicken this time. Budget cuts 😂
Of course
My nephew needs summer work for the last two weeks before school. Any picking left?
Send him over on the 20th. We start Zestar then
He'll be there. Boots and all
Saw your truck pull out at 5 this morning. You ever sleep?
Not lately 😅
Take a day off before picking starts
Wish I could
Equipment auction tomorrow morning in Knoxville. You going?
Yeah, leaving early. Looking for a used bin trailer
See you there. I'll bring coffee
Did you eat today? Your father says you were out in the cold since five.
Yes Mom. Had eggs. Pruning on the south block.
Good. Pruning in February, honestly.
Can you pick up his prescription at Hy-Vee? I'm at the church sale until 4.
Sure. I'll swing by after the Kubota place.
Thank you honey
Got it. Dropped it on your counter.
You're a good boy ❤️
Did you eat breakfast or just coffee again
Eggs. Toast. Ask Tug, he watched me the whole time
Good. Your father wants to know if the pruning crew starts this week
Next week if the ground firms up. Tell him it's 14 degrees, he can look out his own window
I'll tell him no such thing 😄
Snow tonight they say. Dad's already checking the barometer.
He's been checking it since 1998.
😂 Don't tell him I laughed
Can you pick up my prescription at Hy-Vee if you're in town? I'll pay you back
Yep. Going by around 2
Bless you. Bring it by and I'll send you home with banana bread
Got it. Left it on your counter, the loaf is in the truck
Annika called. She's thinking of coming for Easter weekend.
Nice. I'll make room. Tug misses her.
Tug misses anyone with cheese
Fair
The church rummage sale is coming up. Do you have any old crates or boxes to donate
I've got about forty bushel crates with cracked slats. Will that do?
Ha, no. Just the kitchen odds and ends in the shed then
Will look. Might take a few days
Do you still have Grandma Ingrid's kringle recipe card? Mine's gone missing.
Should be in the blue tin in the farmhouse pantry. Will look.
Found it. Will send a picture later, hands are covered in grease
No rush. Easter is two weeks out.
Church ham dinner Sunday at noon. You and Lainey coming?
We'll try. Depends on frost. Forecast is iffy.
Frost, frost. The apples will do what they do.
Yes ma'am
Dr. Okafor's office called, your dad's appointment moved to 2:30 next week.
Can you drive him? I've got the sprayer down.
Of course. He'll grumble the whole way.
Frost warning tonight. Your father is already calling the neighbors
I know. We've got the wind machines and I'm lighting the burn barrels at 2
Wear the warm coat, not the denim one
Yes ma'am
Blossoms made it through?
Mostly. Lost a little on the low block by the creek. Could've been way worse
Thank the Lord. I lit a candle anyway
Tulip Time parade tomorrow! Dad wants to park at your place and walk.
Fine by me. Lots of people at the market though. I'll have coffee on.
Wonderful
That was a lot of people 😅 Thank you for the coffee.
Sold out of cider by one. Got to bring more next time.
That's wonderful sweetheart. Proud of you.
Did you see the hail warning?
Yeah. Crew's covering the young block. Fingers crossed.
I lit a candle
Mom 😄
Missed us. Just wind and rain.
Thank the Lord
Mrs. Van Zee asked about you at the post office. Says her nephew needs summer work
Tell him to come by the shed in the morning. Picking doesn't start until late August but I can use help thinning
Rhubarb is coming in like crazy. Want a bag?
Yes please. Lainey wants to make that crisp.
I'll leave it on your porch.
Got it. Tug sniffed the whole bag.
Your father wants to know what the corn looks like along 163.
Knee high by the Fourth like always. Tell him it's looking fine.
He'll be pleased.
Fourth of July at our place. I'm making the potato salad. Bring something sweet.
Apple pie okay?
Please don't bring me an apple pie from an apple orchard, bring a surprise
Peach cobbler then 🍑
Perfect
Dad says the fireworks in town were loud. Tug ok?
Hid under the table till ten.
The church picnic is coming up, I'll need folding tables
I'll bring the two from the barn.
Supper's at six if you want to come by. Pot roast.
Cord, you got a minute to look at the pump invoice? Numbers don't add up
Send me a picture of the line items. I'm at the co-op tomorrow afternoon
Will do. You're a lifesaver
Found it. They charged tax twice. I flagged it in the sheet
Knew it. Thanks buddy. Beer's on me at the game
Casey's coffee? Roads are slick, I'm early.
Be there in 10.
Got your usual.
You're a saint
Hawkeye basketball tonight? I've got a TV and a bad couch
Can't. Early start tomorrow
You and your early starts. Man needs a social life
Man needs apples to not freeze
Fair
Need a hand moving my baler this weekend if you're free
Morning works.
Appreciate it.
Baler's in. Owe you a fish fry.
Deal.
Heard on the radio frost risk tomorrow night
Yup. We're ready. Wind machine and smudge pots.
Old school. I'm lighting brush piles.
You watch the Hawkeye spring game?
Caught the second half. Offense looked okay.
Defense carried.
Always does. Dad says the same.
Does your sprayer have a spare nozzle tip? Mine cracked.
Got some in the shed. Come by.
On my way.
Got it. Thanks. Owe you a beer.
You owe me like six of those.
Rain tonight, fingers crossed for a real one.
Gauge will tell.
Hauling cull apples to the hog guy next week. Need your trailer?
Sure. Hitch is the 2-inch ball. Bring it back with gas in it
Yes sir
Tank full. Thanks again
Co-op annual meeting needs setup help. You're on the books so they'll ask you.
Already did. Tables and chairs.
Good man.
Dry spell is brutal. Irrigating?
Drip lines on the young trees. Old trees are on their own.
Same with my hay.
Fall football tailgate planning. Are we doing the north lot again?
Yeah. I'll bring the smoker.
I'll bring the cornhole.
Anyone around who wants a free shepherd mix? Neighbor's moving.
Tug would sulk. Pass.
😄 figured.
Derecho hit the grain bins east of town. Heard anything?
Dad said it missed us. Checking on Hendricks' place later.
Good of you.
Wanna get a coffee tomorrow before you do the books?
Sure. 7 AM at Casey's.
Pella Farmers Market: Vendor spots for the new season are open. Confirm your stall by reply.
Confirming stall 14, same as last year
Confirmed. Setup starts at 6:30 AM.
Pella Farmers Market: Vendor stall B-14 is confirmed for this season.
Thanks. We'll have early Zestar apples by August.
Great. Setup opens at 6:30 AM. Please park behind the bandstand.
Heads up: tent inspection next week. Bring your weights.
Will do. Sandbags in the truck
Thanks! Great season so far.
Can we swap to a corner stall? Lots of foot traffic by the bakery.
Corner C-2 is open this month. We'll switch you.
Appreciate it.
Reminder: vendor check-in opens at 6:30 AM tomorrow. Please arrive before 7.
Got it. Do you have stall 14 again?
Yes, stall 14 is yours for the season.
Thanks. Bringing early apples next time, fresh cider too
Wonderful! We'll put you on the Facebook page.
Reminder: vendor fee of $25 for August is due at check-in.
Will pay at the table
Weather looks clear. Hoping for a big crowd!
Fingers crossed
Reminder: cider labeling rules posted in the vendor group. Please review.
Group text! Dad figured out how to join. Say hi Erik.
Hi.
lol dad
Welcome to the 21st century
Sunday dinner is at 5, roast chicken
Be there
Can't, working weekend
We'll save you leftovers
Dad's physical went fine. Cholesterol a little up.
Doctor exaggerates.
Dad. Eat a vegetable.
Pickles count.
Easter pics! Everyone looks so nice.
Mom, my eyes were closed in all of them
Not true
One was good. The one with Tug.
Dog photos always best.
Tulip Time parade tomorrow, I packed folding chairs
Bring a jacket. Cold wind.
I can't make it this year, sorry! Next year.
We understand honey
Who's bringing what for Memorial Day
I'll do buns and the good mustard
I've got apple cider and a cooler
I'll grill
You always grill, Dad. That's not a contribution, that's a hobby
Annika 😂
Memorial Day: I'm bringing deviled eggs
I got chips
Grill's cleaned. Brats and burgers.
Charcoal. Not gas.
It's charcoal Dad.
Pictures from the lake last week are in the shared album if anybody wants them
Mom, there are 94 photos of the same duck
It was a very photogenic duck
Can't make Dad's cookout on the 12th. Picking crew orientation. Sorry
It's not a cookout, it's a gathering
Dad it's burgers in the yard
Come after, there'll be leftovers. There are always leftovers
Will do. Save me a plate
Annika, did you call your landlord?
Mom!! Yes. Not fixed.
Dad can come look at your sink
Bring tools.
It's fine I'll call a plumber
Fourth of July menu: potato salad, coleslaw, brats, peach cobbler
Sparklers?
No, last time you lit the hay.
That was one time.
Ten years ago and we still talk about it 😆
Thank you all for yesterday. Good day.
Great food, Mom.
Reminder the church directory photos are due. Everyone wear something that isn't flannel
Define flannel
Dad.
I own one collared shirt. It's blue. It'll do
Church picnic is coming. I signed us up for desserts.
I'll bring brownies from a box. Don't judge.
Judging.
Tables are loaded in my truck.
Weather looks nasty. Everybody ok?
Barn roof held.
Orchard fine. Some leaf shred, no fruit loss.
Phew
Football schedule is out. Dad's marked the calendar.
Season opener. Circled in red.
Of course he did.
Cord, Wendell. Hay wagon's yours if you still need it
Appreciate it. I'll pick it up this afternoon
Tires are low. Pump is in the shed
Got it
Cord, Wendell Burke. Your mixed-fruit order is ready at the depot
Thanks Wendell. I'll pick up this afternoon
Dock closes at 4
Understood
Frost warning tonight. Down to 28. Your blossoms ok?
Not open yet on most blocks. Running the fans on the low end just in case
Good. My wife's tulips are done for
Sorry to hear that. Tell her I'll bring her a pie when the Lodis come in
She'll hold you to it
Your dog is on my porch again
Sorry!! Coming to get him
No hurry. He's eating my cat's dinner but he seems happy
😂 I owe you a bag of cat food
Pricing sheet for next season attached to the email I just sent
Got it. Will look it over and call you
No hurry. Just need numbers by end of the month
Will have it to you in two weeks
Perfect
Got a spare sprayer nozzle? Mine cracked
Got two in the shop. Yellow tip, 0.4. Take whichever
That's the one. I'll swing by
Sent the counter-offer on the case price. Take a look
Hail on the radar heading east. Might clip you
Thanks for the heads up. Nothing I can do about it but pray
Went north of us. Lucky
Whew
Corn's tasseling early. Dry July coming I think
Dad says the same. He's been staring at the sky for a week
Your dad's usually right. Annoying that way
Hawkeyes got a new quarterback. You following that?
Of course. Cautiously optimistic
Cautiously. That's what I said in 2019 😅
Can I borrow your post hole digger this month? Gate post rotted out
Sure. It's hooked on the old Ford. Take it, just bring it back with fuel
Will do
Brought it back. Filled the tank. Left you a jar of my wife's pickles on the tailgate
Found them. Thank her for me
Saw your lights on pretty late a few times lately. Everything alright?
Just a lot of paperwork this time of year. Thanks for asking
Well, you know where I am. Coffee's always on
Rain in the forecast tomorrow. Half an inch maybe
We could use it
Agreed. Tell your dad he can stop staring now
🤣 Will do
You see the game last night
Fell asleep in the third quarter. Don't tell me the ending
Overtime. Missed free throw. I'm not okay
I said don't tell me
Sorry man 😅
Yo. Red Rock is supposed to be 50s and sunny next week. Ice fishing's over, crappie are biting
Haha it's February man. Ice is still on half the lake
Fine, you're right. Spring then
You doing the fantasy league again this year?
Ask me in August. Orchard eats my whole spring
Last year you won with a kicker and a prayer 😂
Skill. Pure skill.
Hawkeyes spring game is on. Want to go?
Can't, bloom's early. I'm out in the trees dawn to dark
Alright. Tell the bees I said hi
Selling my old smoker. You still want it?
What are you asking
Eighty bucks. Needs a new gasket
Deal. I'll grab it Sunday afternoon after chores
My truck needs new brakes and the guy quoted me $640. Is that insane
For all four wheels with rotors? Not crazy. Try Pella Auto & Tire, they're fair
Good call, I'll ring them
Got it done for $520. Thanks man
Told you
Tulip Time parade tomorrow. Hannah's got the kids in costume. You coming into town?
Might catch the end. Mom's got a spot on the square
Cool. Save me a funnel cake
Saw you at the parade, you looked half dead lol
Up at five every day since March. I'm a zombie in a trucker cap
Tried the smoker. Ribs came out great. Thanks man
Told you. Gasket was nothing
Come to the cookout on the Fourth. Grill's on me
What time?
Around 4. Bring a dessert, Lainey's pie if she's up for it
I'll ask her
Good seeing you yesterday. Brats were solid
Best brats in Marion County. Tug is still sulking you didn't give him one
I slipped him half of one when nobody was looking
That explains the guilty face 😂
Fantasy football draft is in three weeks. You in again
Yeah. Last place again probably
Someone has to hold the trophy for losers 😂
Draft is in 3 weeks. You in or not
Put me down. Auto-draft if I'm in the orchard
Auto-draft is how you won last time, so I don't trust it
Ha
You alright man? Haven't heard from you in a bit
Yeah just busy. Thinning, spraying, all of it
Alright. Beers when you surface

I'll bring my toolbox. Probably the roller.

Can you work Tuesday instead of Wednesday next week? Board meeting moved.
That works. I'll switch.
Fuel invoices for June are in. 41 of them. Sorry.
Ugh. I'll tackle them first thing.
Coffee's on us tomorrow
Deal

Draft sent, check your email
Got it. Looks clean, thank you.
Seed order from the Pioneer rep is off by 20 bags. Can you reconcile?
Will compare the packing slip to the PO tomorrow.

Thank you!! You're a lifesaver
Office is closed Monday for the fair. See you after.
Ok, enjoy the fair.

Tomorrow after chores ok?
Sure. I'll be in the north block spraying till 4
Got it. Left a six pack on your porch step
Appreciate it. Tug already tried to open it
Red Rock is giving up crappie like crazy. You in?
Can't this week. Codling moth traps are lit up
Always something with you lol
Apples don't care what day it is
Fish fry at the Legion tonight. Mom's making the slaw
I'll try. Co-op books tomorrow so I might make it
Try harder
You hitting the fireworks at the lake or staying put?
Staying put. Tug loses his mind
Fair. Poor guy
You know anybody selling a decent used stock trailer? Dad's is shot

Perfect thx
He wants 4,200. Sound right?
Check the floor boards and the axle. Take Josh if you want a second set of eyes
Will do
Bought it. Floor's solid. Axle needed new bearings so he knocked off 300
Good deal. Congrats
Heat index 108 tomorrow. Brutal
Crew starts at 5 AM so they're done before noon. Pushing water on everybody
Smart
Feed store has the new Hawkeye hats in. Want one?
I've got three already
One for the dog then
Casey's has a two large deal tonight. Come over, the preseason replay is on
Can't, too much to do. Rain's coming tomorrow and I need to get the sprayer filled
Alright. Take care of yourself man
Heads up, rain tonight. I'd cover the hay
Already tarped. Thanks
Reminder: Dad's eye appointment is at 2 tomorrow. Erik, do NOT cancel again.
I never cancelled. I rescheduled.
Three times, Dad 😂
I can drive him if you're stuck in the rows, Cord
I got him. Spraying wraps up by noon.
Radar shows a line coming through around 4. Keep the windows shut on the truck.
Dad it's a holiday, we're grilling not planting
Brats or burgers? I'm bringing the potato salad either way
Brats. I'll bring the good mustard from the market
Can someone bring ice? Mine's all gone
Casey's has bags. I'll grab two on the way.
Thanks for coming everyone. Leftovers in the blue cooler, Cord, take them home to Lainey
Got them. Thanks Mom.
Hawkeyes season tickets came in the mail. Row 22 again.
Can I have the first game? I'll drive over from Ames
You can have it if you wear the black and gold and not that purple thing
It's NOT purple, it's plum 🙄
Lord. Your grandfather would be proud of this family.
Annika, did the clinic ever get that Lab's cast off?
Yesterday! He walked out like he owned the place. Dr. Kessler gave him a whole bag of treats.
Tug would never forgive me if he got treats and she didn't
Hail on the west side of town last night. Check your trees, Cord.
Already walked the north block. A few leaves shredded, fruit looks fine.
Thank goodness. Come to supper and tell me all about it
Church potluck is the 9th. Mom signed you up for rolls, Cord
I did not sign him up, I signed up Lainey. She said she'd make them.
I'll ask her. She's got a deposition prep thing that week.
Store-bought is fine. Nobody has to know.
Everyone will know. It's Pella.
Dad's got his new reading glasses. Look how serious he is
Where's the photo, Mom?
I can't figure out how to send it in this thing. Never mind.
Press the paperclip, Mom. Or just show us at supper.
Rain totals: 1.4 inches. Good for the late varieties.
Dad has now sent the rain total to every person he knows
Gladly. It's the best news all summer.
Annika, are you coming in for the potluck or just the game weekend?
Both if my shift swap goes through. Will confirm tomorrow ❤️
Sprayer's leaking at the left nozzle again.
Swap the gasket. Spare's in the blue bin by the door.
Done. Scab pressure's bad after that rain.
Yep. We go again at five tomorrow.
Lainey called my house phone looking for you.
Told her you were at mine with the heifer again. That's the last time, Cord.
I know. I owe you.
You owe her a conversation, not me.
Soon. Not yet.
I've known her since we were sixteen. She deserves better than my bad lying.
Understood.
Crew's at the north block at six. You coming?
On my way.
Frost forecast is clear till September. Honeycrisp are sizing up nice.
Good. Count the bins before the crew starts. We're short.
Counted. 212 usable. Need about 40 more.
I'll call the co-op about the rest.
Auction's early tomorrow. You still want that used atomizer?
If it's under two grand. I'm leaving at six.
I'll meet you there. Bring the trailer hitch pin.
Fantasy league's back. Draft is August 22, same rules
Is Brent still commissioner or did he get fired
Commissioner for life
Last year's trophy still has my name on it, just saying
Because you got lucky
Pay your dues this time Dean
I paid!
My records say otherwise
Ticket office emailed. Season ticket renewal deadline is end of the month
Anyone splitting a pair?
I'll take half if it's the lower bowl. Can't swing a full pair this year
Deal
I'll take the other pair with Dean
Works
Happy Fourth. Who's grilling
Me. Brats and corn, come over after dark
Can't, we're dealing with a late spray. Save me a brat
Always working
Preseason magazine says we win the West
They say that every year
Offensive line looks solid though
Defense is the story
Kicker is the story. Mark my words
lol
Tailgate spot: same lot as last year?
That lot sold out already. Dean, your cousin still have the pass for the gravel lot?
Yep, I'll ask him
Who's bringing the smoker for the opener
Cord's got the big one
I do. Hickory chips are in the shed
Pulled pork then
I'll bring slaw and the beer
Reminder draft is August 22 at Dean's garage
Garage is air conditioned now. I put in a window unit
Finally, civilization
Last call for dues, $40 each
Sending tonight
Thanks. Brent is a tyrant
Tyrant with a spreadsheet
Ha. Nobody argue with the spreadsheet
Cord, we're short two ladders for the Honeycrisp block
There's four in the back of the shed behind the mower
Found them. One has a cracked rung.
Tag it and set it aside. Don't climb it.
Already did. Red tape.
My cousin Mateo needs work through August. He's quick and careful.
Send him by at 6 tomorrow. Bring gloves.
Thank you boss 🙏
Mateo did good. Thinned the whole east row by himself.
Saw that. Good eye. Keep him on.
Sprayer is making that squealing sound again
Probably the belt. I'll call the Kubota guys for a part.
Want me to shut it down till then?
Yes. Finish the mowing and the irrigation lines instead.
I need to leave at 2 on the 12th, kid has a dentist thing
No problem. Make up the hours whenever.
Found some scab on the Jonathan trees by the creek
Send me a picture when you get a signal
No signal down there. I'll bring a leaf up to you.
Ha. Ok. Put it in a paper bag, not plastic.
Bin count for the early Galas: 86
Better than last year. Thanks Hector.
Tug got into the truck again and ate half my lunch 😅
I'm sorry. I'll buy you a sandwich.
Don't be sorry, she's a good dog. Just lock the door.
Are we picking the Ginger Golds next week?
Looks like it. Check the starch test Friday morning and tell me.
Will do.
Starch looks about 3. Needs a few more days.
Ok. We'll hold off then. Thanks.
Picking starts soon. Shifts post here by Friday.
How many ladders do we have?
Twenty-two good ones, four with bad rungs.
I can bring my brother's ladders.
Please do. Bring gloves too.
Bins arrive from the co-op tomorrow morning.
Which block first?
Gala block, then Honeycrisp. Start at six.
I can do mornings only this week. Dentist in the afternoon.
Mornings are fine.
Who's bringing water jugs?
I've got the big cooler.
I'll bring ice.
Heads up: heat advisory. Breaks every hour, shade tent by the shed.
Copy that.
Bad rung on ladder 17, tagged it red.
Thanks Luis. Pull it from the rack.
Shift sheet is on the shed door. Check your name.
I'm on the second shift. Thanks.
Bring your own lunch. The truck won't make it Thursday.
Cord, you still got that old Farmall in the back barn?
Still there. Hasn't run since Grandpa.
I might have a carburetor kit that fits. Found it cleaning out my garage.
Bring it by and we'll see. Might get it running for the parade.
Parade in Pella is in October. We have time.
Saw your dad at the feed store. He says the Honeycrisp look good.
They're sizing up well, Uncle Lars.
I'll bring a few crates of my sweet corn when I come by.
Lainey will love that.
Coming out this weekend. Need anything from town?
A bag of dog food, the 40 lb kind from the farm supply. Tug's almost out.
Done.
Good seeing the place. Your dad's got that look when he talks weather
Ha. Which look?
The one where he's already decided it's going to hail
Hail did come, so he wins
Don't tell him that. He'll be insufferable.
Farmall fires on two cylinders now. Third one coughs.
That's progress! Check the plugs on the third.
Swapped them. Fires clean on all three. Smells like 1985 in the barn.
Best smell on earth. Send a video.
Phone's too dusty. Come see it.
Will do. Aunt Dee wants to send a casserole for you and Lainey.
Tell her thank you. We'll eat it all.
Tuna or chicken-rice?
Chicken-rice please.
Smart answer.
Fish fry at the lodge soon. Bring that girl of yours.
We'll see if we can make it.
Casserole dropped on the porch. Dish is Pyrex, I want it back.
Got it. Thanks, it smells great. Dish will come back clean.
Appreciate it. Keep your chin up, Cord. You look tired.
Long season. I'm ok.
Radar shows a line coming through by supper.
Saw it. Covering the bins.
Rain gauge says an inch and a quarter. Good for the Gala block.
Good.
Hawkeyes open the season against a team I never heard of.
They'll win by thirty.
Wind's picking up out of the northwest. Check the netting.
Will do tomorrow.
Dry week ahead. Mark it down.
You alive out there? Haven't seen you since the Fourth
Barely. Spray season and the co-op books. Both at once.
That's what you get for being the responsible one
Fishing at Lake Red Rock when it cools off? I'll bring the boat.
Maybe the middle of August. Ask me closer.
You said that last year
And we went. Once.
Did you see the Hawkeyes schedule? Opener at home 🔥
Dad's already got his seat cushion out
Tailgate in the usual lot?
Yep. I'll bring the brats and a cooler.
I'll handle the beer and the chairs
Bro my truck's transmission is toast. $3,800 quote.
Ouch. Try Pella Auto & Tire for a second opinion, they're honest.
Good call. Booked for tomorrow.
They said it's a sensor. $240.
There you go 😄
I owe you a beer. Maybe two.
Make it three
Kelsey wants to know if you and Lainey can come to dinner. Burgers on the grill.
I'll check with her. Work's been heavy.
No rush. Just tell us.
Any good podcast for the tractor? I'm out of stuff.
The one about the Dust Bowl. Long but great.
Downloading it now
Dude, episode 3 😳 I had no idea
Told you
Did you eat today? You looked thin at supper.
I ate, Mom. Egg sandwich from Casey's.
That's not eating. Come Sunday, I'm making the pork roast.
Bea left her scarf after supper the other night. I'll hold it for her.
Tell Lainey before those invitations go out, honey.
I know, Mom. Please don't push.
I'm not pushing. I'm a mother. Lainey made my pie crust better than I do.
I'll handle it.
Your father wants to know if you're coming to the Hawkeyes tailgate.
Tell him maybe. Picking starts soon.
Call me tonight. Not late. I go to bed at nine.
Will do.
Good morning honey. Did you get the card I sent? Kaylee graduated nursing school!
Yes ma'am, got it. Tell her congratulations from me
I will. She starts at the hospital in Des Moines in the fall
That's great
I need a bushel of last fall's apples for the church pie sale. Any left in cold storage?
A few bushels of Jonagolds left in the cooler. I'll set one aside
Bless you. I'll pay you
No you won't
Pie sale made $640. Pastor Mike says thank you
Glad it went well
Your Uncle Lars says you're not eating. Are you eating?
I'm eating, Dee. Casey's breakfast burritos count
That is not a vegetable
There's jalapeño in it
Doctor says the new hip is healing nice
Good to hear. Take it easy on the stairs
Yes yes
Making a big batch of kringle for the family reunion. How many are coming from your side?
Mom said about eight. I'll check
Wonderful. Bring Tug
Saw your dad at the grocery. Talked about rain for 20 minutes
That's him
Bless him
Found Grandma Ingrid's lefse recipe in my tin. Want a copy?
Yes please
I'll mail it
Reunion is August 16 at the Pella city park shelter. Noon
Got it. I'll bring cider donuts
Mom says you listed the orchard. YOU LISTED THE ORCHARD??
It wasn't an easy call, Annie.
Great-grandpa planted those trees by hand. And you couldn't even call me first?
The numbers don't work anymore. I'm sorry.
I'm not talking to you for a while.
Okay.
Lainey and I are doing the final dress fitting soon. She's so happy. Don't ruin her mood with all this.
I won't.
Did Tug get his shots? The clinic called me by mistake.
Yes. Last month.
Still mad at you. But pass me the good butter recipe Lainey makes.
Ask her yourself.
Kubota of Pella: your order for 1 drive belt (part #K-2217) has arrived. Pick up anytime during business hours.
Thanks. Can someone hold it till 4?
Sure, we're open until 5:30.
Hey Cord, quick question, what's the hour reading on your L3901?
Just under 1,480.
Then it's due for the 1,500 hour service. We can fit you in the 22nd.
Do I need to leave it overnight?
Drop off in the morning, ready by 4.
Works. See you at 7.
Service complete. Changed oil, hydraulic filter, greased everything. Invoice is $386.40.
Great, I'll swing by in the morning to pay.
Also, we noticed the front tire has some sidewall cracking. Want a quote?
Not this month. Maybe after harvest.
Understood. Just keep an eye on it.
Reminder: our fall equipment demo day is coming up. Free lunch.
Free lunch is the only reason I'd go 😄
Honest answer, we like that. See you there.

notes.title: Spray schedule
notes.body:
Block A (Gala): captan + sulfur, every 10 days until petal fall
Block B (Honeycrisp): watch scab pressure after rain
Block C (Fuji): codling moth traps checked Mondays
Ruben runs the rig at 5 AM. Wind under 8 mph or we wait.
Gasket spares in the blue bin by the door.

notes.title: Frost watch
notes.body:
Low spots by the north block get hit first.
Wind machine fuel: half a tank. Fill up.
Check the thermometers in the north block and the creek block.
Alarm on the weather app for anything under 34.
Smudge pots are in the back of the equipment shed behind the old sprayer.
Late-season fruit still on the trees, so watch the forecast.

notes.body:
Column F: =SUMIF(B:B,"Fuel",E:E) keeps returning 0. Check that the text isn't stored with a trailing space.
